title: Check: Consistent Prefixes and Session Guarantees

questions.prompt: Why is consistent prefix reading free within one partition with a single leader?
options: The log is applied in order

questions.prompt: What's often the best fix for answers appearing before questions?
options: Keep a conversation's messages in the conversation's partition

questions.prompt: What's the strongest consistency model that needs no coordination and stays available during partitions? (one word)
Which tools summarize causal dependencies compactly?
options: Version vectors or hybrid logical clocks

questions.prompt: Which session guarantee prevents "my delete was applied before my create"?
Session guarantees are cheap because they need only per-session metadata, not coordination between replicas.
Which model has every reader see the latest write, as if there were one copy?
Which operation most needs a linearizable read?
options: Checking that a username is still free
